title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Uplift Where Responses Have Been Missed Before
content:
| Calls completed in the current program year carrying a response recorded as missed | The uplift |
|---|---|
| three or more | 1.25 |
| exactly two | 1.1 |
| fewer than two | no uplift for earlier missed responses is applied |

The count is taken over the calls completed on the rate program under the Demand Service Rate Programs
in the current program year, and it counts the calls whose records carry the response as missed,
including the call the credit arises from.

**Both sides of the counts (hypothetical).** A program year in which two completed calls carry a
response recorded as missed gives an uplift of 1.1; a third such call in the same program year takes the
uplift to 1.25, and a fourth and fifth leave it at 1.25, three or more being the whole of that
condition. A program year carrying a single such call gives no uplift for earlier missed responses.
